questions.stem: What is the name given to the system that includes all living organisms and their physical surroundings?
questions.solution: An ecosystem is the term used to describe the system that includes all living organisms and their physical surroundings. The environment refers to the surroundings but not the interacting system of organisms. The biosphere is the global sum of all ecosystems, and a community refers only to the living organisms in an area, not their physical surroundings.

hi.stem: सभी जीवित जीवों और उनके भौतिक वातावरण के समावेश वाले प्रणाली के नाम क्या है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a biodegradable substance?
questions.solution: Leaves are an example of a biodegradable substance because they can be broken down by natural processes involving microorganisms. Plastic bags and metal cans do not break down easily in the environment, making them non-biodegradable. Glass bottles also resist natural decomposition, so they are not biodegradable.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक जैव अपघटनीय पदार्थ का उदाहरण है?
hi.solution: पत्ते एक जैव अपघटनीय पदार्थ का उदाहरण हैं क्योंकि उन्हें सूक्ष्मजीवों के साथ प्राकृतिक प्रक्रियाओं द्वारा अपघटित किया जा सकता है। प्लास्टिक के बैग और धातु के कैन पर्यावरण में आसानी से अपघटित नहीं होते हैं, जिसके कारण वे अजैव अपघटनीय होते हैं। कांच के बोतल भी प्राकृतिक अपघटन के प्रति प्रतिरोध करते हैं, इसलिए वे जैव अपघटनीय नहीं होते हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and solution, with appropriate technical terms used in a Hindi-medium context.

questions.stem: What is the main reason for the decrease in ozone layer thickness?
questions.solution: The main reason for the decrease in ozone layer thickness is the use of chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), which release chlorine atoms that break down ozone molecules in the stratosphere. Deforestation and industrial pollution do not directly affect the ozone layer, and natural climate change is not a primary cause of ozone depletion.

hi.stem: ओज़ोन परत की मोटाई में कमी का मुख्य कारण क्या है?
hi.solution: ओज़ोन परत की मोटाई में कमी का मुख्य कारण क्लोरोफ्लूरोकार्बन (CFCs) के उपयोग है, जो स्ट्रैटोस्फीयर में ओज़ोन अणुओं को तोड़ देते हैं। वनोन्मूलन और औद्योगिक प्रदूषण ओज़ोन परत पर सीधे प्रभाव नहीं डालते हैं, और प्राकृतिक जलवायु परिवर्तन ओज़ोन क्षय के मुख्य कारण नहीं है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as found in Hindi-medium textbooks.

mr.stem: ओझोन थराच्या जास्तीच्या घटीचे मुख्य कारण काय आहे?
mr.solution: ओझोन थराच्या जास्तीच्या घटीचे मुख्य कारण क्लोरोफ्लुओरोकार्बन (CFCs) चा वापर आहे, जो स्ट्रॅटोस्फियरमधील ओझोन अणूंना तोडून टाकतो. वनतोड आणि औद्योगिक दूषण ओझोन थरावर सीधा परिणाम करत नाहीत, आणि प्राकृतिक जलवायू बदल ओझोन निर्माणाचे मुख्य कारण नाहीत.

questions.stem: If a pond is left without cleaning, what might happen to the ecosystem in the long run?
choices: It could become polluted and unhealthy
questions.solution: If a pond is left without cleaning, waste and excess nutrients can accumulate, leading to pollution and harming the organisms that live there. This makes the ecosystem unhealthy over time. The other options are incorrect because increased diversity, no change, and self-sufficiency do not align with the effects of neglecting an ecosystem.

questions.stem: If a food chain has five trophic levels, what is the most likely impact on energy availability?
choices: Energy remains the same at each level
Energy is evenly distributed across all levels
questions.solution: Energy decreases at each level because organisms use energy for life processes, and only a fraction is passed on to the next level. This loss occurs as heat and through metabolic activities. Energy does not increase, stay the same, or distribute evenly because of these inherent losses in energy transfer.

questions.stem: Why do non-biodegradable substances like plastics persist in the environment for a long time?
choices: They are not broken down by biological processes
They are made of organic materials
They are not affected by sunlight
questions.solution: Non-biodegradable substances like plastics persist because they are not broken down by biological processes such as those involving bacteria or fungi. Water and sunlight may affect some materials, but they do not prevent decomposition in the way that biological processes do.
